description:
Rose Property presents:

1 Hettyfield Gardens, Douglas, Cork to the market this superb four bedroom semi detached home, ideally positioned in the highly sought after area of Douglas, Cork.

Offering spacious and well proportioned accommodation throughout, this attractive property provides an excellent opportunity to acquire a beautiful home in a mature and established residential setting.

The property offers bright and comfortable accommodation arranged over three floors, with well balanced living and bedroom space. The generous layout provides excellent flexibility for modern living, with four bedrooms offering a variety of options for bedrooms, guest accommodation or home office use.

Upon entering, a welcoming hallway leads to the principal living accommodation. The spacious living room provides a comfortable and inviting setting, while the kitchen and dining area offers a practical space for everyday living and entertaining. The ground floor is further complemented by useful storage and access to the rear garden.

The first floor comprises of three generously proportioned bedrooms, including a bedroom with an ensuite, along with the main bathroom. The entire second floor is dedicated to the impressive master bedroom, which enjoys a spacious and private setting and is further complemented by its own ensuite. The property has been finished to an exceptional standard throughout, with a carefully selected range of high quality fixtures, fittings and finishes creating a stylish and sophisticated interior.

Externally, the property benefits from a private rear garden, providing a pleasant outdoor space for relaxing and entertaining. To the front, there is parking, complemented by the attractive surroundings of this established development. 

Hettyfield Gardens enjoys an enviable position in Douglas, one of Cork's most desirable and well connected residential areas. Douglas Village is within easy reach and offers an excellent selection of cafés, restaurants, bars, shops, supermarkets and everyday amenities.

The area also benefits from a wide range of schools, sporting facilities and recreational amenities, while excellent transport links provide convenient access to Cork City Centre, the South Ring Road network, Cork Airport and surrounding areas. A2 energy rating. Built 2023.
